items.text: Sufficient care is required when pulling out and inserting wiring connectors.

subitems.label: (a)
subitems.text: Release the lock and pull out the connector, pulling on the connectors.

content.description: Hands fully inserting and locking a connector

items.label: (b)
items.text: Fully insert the connector and insure that it is locked.

content.description: Hands removing water-proofing rubber from a connector

items.text: When inspecting a connector with a volt/ohmmeter.

subitems.label: (a)
subitems.text: Carefully take out the water-proofing rubber if it is a water-proof type connector.

content.description: Tester probe being inserted into connector from wiring side

items.label: (b)
items.text: Insert the tester probe into the connector from the wiring side when checking the continuity, amperage or voltage.

items.label: (c)
items.text: Do not apply unnecessary force to the terminal.

items.label: (d)
items.text: After checking, install the water-proofing rubber on the connector securely.
